## ⛔ Hard Stops Triggered (§ 2 / § E)

This contract contains **four prohibited terms**. Any one forces a Critical rating and GC sign-off; this contract has four:

1. **Uncapped liability** (clause 4.1)
2. **Indemnity for the counterparty's own negligence** (clause 5.1)
3. **Perpetual assignment of our pre-existing IP** (clause 6.1)
4. **Most-favoured-customer pricing** (clause 3.3)

Plus a fifth prohibited category — **governing law in a high-risk jurisdiction** (clause 10.1) — and **unrestricted no-notice audit rights** (clause 8.1).

**This contract cannot proceed in its current form.**

## Findings

| Rule ID | Clause | Severity | Risk identified | Ref | Recommended action |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| LIA-01 | Limitation of liability | 🔴 Critical | Liability is unlimited / uncapped | 4.1 | Reject. Insert cap at 12 months' fees. Escalate to GC. |
| IND-02 | Indemnification | 🔴 Critical | We indemnify counterparty for *their own* negligence | 5.1 | Remove entirely. Never indemnify a counterparty for their own fault. |
| IND-01 | Indemnification | 🔴 Critical | Indemnity is uncapped | 5.1 | Cap indemnity at the liability limit. Escalate to GC. |
| IP-01 | IP ownership | 🔴 Critical | Assignment of our pre-existing / background IP | 6.1 | Reject assignment. Convert to a licence grant. Escalate to GC. |
| DP-01 | Data Processing Agreement | 🔴 Critical | Personal data processed with **no DPA** present | 7.1 | Do not sign. Require a UK GDPR-compliant DPA with SCCs. |
| COM-02 | MFN pricing | 🔴 Critical* | Most-favoured-customer pricing clause | 3.3 | Remove. MFN clauses require GC approval. |
| GOV-01 | Governing law | 🟠 High | Governing law in a high-risk / non-EU jurisdiction | 10.1 | Negotiate to England & Wales. Escalate if counterparty insists. |
| MISC-02 | Audit rights | 🟠 High | Unrestricted audit, no notice or scope limit | 8.1 | Limit to once yearly, on reasonable notice, scoped to compliance. |
| TRM-01 | Termination for convenience | 🟠 High | No termination-for-convenience right for us | 2.3 | Add a termination-for-convenience right with ≤ 60 days' notice. |
| IP-02 | Licence grant | 🟠 High | Assignment is perpetual and irrevocable | 6.1 | Make any grant co-terminous and revocable on termination. |
| TRM-02 | Auto-renewal | 🟡 Medium | Auto-renews with 90-day notice window (> 60 days) | 2.2 | Reduce renewal-notice window to ≤ 60 days; flag renewal date. |
| COM-01 | Payment terms | 🟡 Medium | Payment terms of 90 days (> 60 days) | 3.2 | Negotiate to ≤ 45 days. |

*COM-02 is rated Medium in the rule table but elevated to Critical here because MFN is a § E hard stop.

## Missing-Clause Gaps (§ 3 / § D)

Expected protections that are **absent** from this contract:

| Expected clause | Impact | Severity | Action |
|---|---|---|---|
| Data Processing Agreement | No GDPR coverage despite PII processing | 🔴 Critical | Require DPA + SCCs before signing |
| Liability cap | Unlimited exposure | 🔴 Critical | Insert liability cap (see LIA-01) |
| Breach notification | No incident obligations on either party | 🟠 High | Add 72-hour breach-notification term |
| Data return / deletion | Data could be retained indefinitely | 🟡 Medium | Add return-and-deletion clause with timeline |
| AI accuracy disclaimer | No disclaimer that output isn't legal advice | 🟡 Medium | Add AI accuracy / human-review disclaimer |

Also missing from mandatory legal-tech clauses (§ D): acceptable-use terms, service-availability/uptime commitment, and sub-processor flow-down obligations.

2. Strike the indemnity for the counterparty's own negligence (5.1)
3. Cap the indemnity at the liability limit (5.1)
4. Reject the IP assignment; convert to a revocable licence (6.1)

9. Add a termination-for-convenience right (2.3)
10. Add breach-notification (72 hours)

**Negotiate where leverage allows (Medium):**

12. Reduce payment terms to ≤ 45 days (3.2)
13. Add data return/deletion, AI disclaimer, and remaining mandatory clauses
